_comment: Single source of truth for LLM routing. Run scripts/update-llm-config.sh after editing to propagate changes.

local.note: Screen/GUI agent work — vision, UI grounding, computer-use trajectories.

overflow.backend: exo cluster (master coordinator + worker inference, RDMA over TB5)
overflow.note: Local Llama-70B-4bit served by exo cluster. Worker hosts the model (48GB RAM); master is coordinator+API at :52415. Single unified endpoint.

fast.purpose: Primary chat, copywriting, function calling, ads analysis, monitoring

reasoning.purpose: Consensus synthesis, strategic analysis, complex reasoning. DeepSeek-V4-Flash MLX (148GB) does not fit current 96GB pooled RAM; Llama-3.3-70B-4bit is the in-cluster substitute until a 3rd 48GB node is added or Xcode is installed on master to unlock pooled mode.
reasoning.deferred: DeepSeek-V4-Flash MLX (mlx-community/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 148GB 8-bit) — load once cluster has >=152GB pooled VRAM.

consensus_engine.note: Required for ALL strategic recommendations and advertising investment decisions. Reasoning + synthesizer run locally on exo cluster (no per-call OpenRouter cost).

image.note: Only route still on Gemini; all text uses fast/reasoning/local/overflow.
